# zillizcloud_service_accounts (Data Source)

Lists all matching Service Accounts, including roles and project assignments. Automatically reads all pages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "zillizcloud_service_accounts" "project" {
  project_id = "proj-a"
  status     = "active"
  name       = "ingestion"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Substring filter for the name.
- `project_id` (String) Assigned project ID filter.
- `service_account_id` (String) Substring filter for the Service Account ID.
- `status` (String) Filter by active or disable status.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) Matching records. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `total_count` (Number) Number of returned items.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) Creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format.
- `created_by` (String) Creator identifier.
- `creator_name` (String) Creator display name.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Service Account ID.
- `name` (String) Account name.
- `org_role_id` (String) Organization role ID, or null when no organization role is granted.
- `project_assignments` (Map of Set of String) Project IDs mapped to granted role ID sets.
- `project_role_ids` (Set of String) Roles in the owning project for a project-local account.
- `project_scope` (String) Owning project ID, or null for an organization account.
- `status` (String) Account status.
